description: This file defines the 'License' entity class for the OrangeHRM application. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the 'ohrm_license' database table, with properties for 'id' and 'name', and manages a collection of 'EmployeeLicense' entities related to each license.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a licensing entity in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for id and name, and a collection of associated EmployeeLicense objects.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the license.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the license.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the license.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the license.
